desc: Atmospheric restaurant with a menu of familiar Italian flavors & a stylish atmosphere.
addr: Navajyothi 1st Floor, 654, 100 Feet Rd, Stage 1, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India

rev.t: One of the better known Italian restaurant chain - quite consistent with their food - the cuisine is all vegetarian with vegan optiond available. The cream of asparagus soup we tried could have been a wee bit more creamy. The desserts too - …

The service is ridiculous. It took nearly half an hour to just get a pizza, that tasted awful. The Napoli pizza has no taste. It felt like I was eating pizza base. Its absurd to charge more than 800 for something like that. The Waiting time …
Really great sauces. The Pasta del Barone tasted amazing even without veggies. The Barbesca is like your usual pasta but with a more intense, richer flavour — really good. …
